node.title: Lean tier 1: gate addition certificates (witnesses computed)
node.statement: The vendored stdlib-only Lean package kernel-checks the Tier-1 F_17^32 gate arithmetic: positive addition witnesses for the 6/7 bracket, B*=6, tangent-cap inclusion, 506/507 staircase values, and 5/512 < 6/512 = 3/256 endpoint conversion. Typed analytic targets remain explicit non-claims.
